parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.status,
    sb.storyboard_json,
    sb.subtitle_lines_json,
    sb.render_manifest_seed_json,
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'scene_number', a.scene_number,
        'asset_role', a.asset_role,
        'provider', a.provider,
        'storage_url', a.storage_url,
        'mime_type', a.mime_type,
        'duration_seconds', a.duration_seconds,
        'width', a.width,
        'height', a.height,
        'metadata_json', a.metadata_json
      )
      order by a.scene_number
    ) filter (where a.asset_role in ('scene_image', 'scene_video') and a.status = 'ready') as scene_assets_json,
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'scene_number', a.scene_number,
        'provider', a.provider,
        'storage_url', a.storage_url,
        'mime_type', a.mime_type,
        'duration_seconds', a.duration_seconds,
        'metadata_json', a.metadata_json
      )
      order by a.scene_number asc
    ) filter (where a.asset_role = 'scene_narration' and a.status = 'ready') as scene_narration_assets_json,
    count(*) filter (where a.asset_role in ('scene_image', 'scene_video') and a.status = 'ready')::int as scene_asset_count,
    count(*) filter (where a.asset_role = 'scene_narration' and a.status = 'ready')::int as scene_narration_count
  from content_items ci
  join storyboards sb on sb.content_id = ci.content_id
  join assets a on a.content_id = ci.content_id
  where ci.status = 'narration_ready'
  group by ci.content_id, ci.title, ci.status, sb.storyboard_json, sb.subtitle_lines_json, sb.render_manifest_seed_json
  having count(*) filter (where a.asset_role in ('scene_image', 'scene_video') and a.status = 'ready') >= 4
     and count(*) filter (where a.asset_role = 'scene_narration' and a.status = 'ready') >= 4
  order by max(ci.updated_at) asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'building_render_manifest',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status = 'narration_ready'
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.status,
  c.storyboard_json,
  c.subtitle_lines_json,
  c.render_manifest_seed_json,
  c.scene_assets_json,
  c.scene_narration_assets_json,
  c.scene_asset_count,
  c.scene_narration_count
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

insert into renders (
  content_id,
  render_manifest_json,
  output_video_url,
  cover_image_url,
  resolution,
  aspect_ratio,
  duration_seconds,
  render_status,
  render_log,
  requested_at,
  completed_at
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.render_manifest_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  null,
  nullif('{{$json.cover_image_url_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.resolution_sql}}', ''),
  nullif('{{$json.aspect_ratio_sql}}', ''),
  {{$json.duration_seconds_sql}},
  '{{$json.render_status_sql}}',
  null,
  now(),
  null
)
on conflict (content_id) do update set
  render_manifest_json = excluded.render_manifest_json,
  output_video_url = excluded.output_video_url,
  cover_image_url = excluded.cover_image_url,
  resolution = excluded.resolution,
  aspect_ratio = excluded.aspect_ratio,
  duration_seconds = excluded.duration_seconds,
  render_status = excluded.render_status,
  render_log = excluded.render_log,
  requested_at = now(),
  completed_at = excluded.completed_at
returning content_id, render_status, resolution, aspect_ratio, duration_seconds;

update content_items
set status = 'render_manifest_ready',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Manifest SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Manifest SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Manifest SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  'success',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Build Render Manifest"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Manifest SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'render_manifest', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Manifest SQL Values"].json["render_manifest_summary_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
